cloudivision.title: Check webhook signatures, redaction, and admission policy
cloudivision.scope: Actual local Go unit-test output for three components. Fixtures exercise signature verification, data redaction, and policy decisions; they do not demonstrate a running Kubernetes controller or a production build. The replay shows each package’s output excerpt from one combined test command.

container-desk.title: Explore the built-in browser demo
container-desk.scope: A recording of the actual browser build from the pinned source version using the project’s clearly labeled synthetic demo fixtures. No native Tauri bridge, SSH connection, or remote Docker operation is involved.
